source_contract: Arbitrary-size finite simple disk G with original ordered induced outer C5 B=(b0,...,b4), fixed original edges and rotation.
Complete ordered Sigma(G)=933/941 or one simultaneous whole-graph D5 image; every nonboundary edge Sigma-critical; epsilon(G)=2.
Effective original H ignores original isolated interior vertices, is connected and full B-touch; ignored isolated vertices remain free full-lift factors.
Exactly two original nonadjacent roots r,s have complete degree5; every other effective original interior vertex has complete degree4.
H minus {r,s} consists exactly of the complete original connected pieces: unique unary U and mixed P,Q; all three one-sided with nonempty actual support.
LOW2: U attaches only to r through exactly rx1,rx2, with x1 distinct from x2, no U-s edge, and all of U retained in X.
P and Q each have actual support exactly both endpoints of a genuine original boundary edge, with positive incidence at each root and preserved named ownership/attachments.
Original mixed incidence (m_r,m_s)=(2,3); r has one contact to P and one to Q; s has one and two, preserving named identity. Original r has exactly one spoke e=rb_i, s exactly two spokes.
For an original rejecting literal beta, X=G-e=M is itself beta inclusion-minimal with root degrees45/54; one common root swap names r as the reduced root.
Only e is omitted. All original vertices, U/P/Q internal edges, root contacts, boundary attachments and other spokes are retained with no added edge, replacement or contraction.

One original graph with named/ordered contacts, a single coordinate for shared vertices, actual support/ownership, bridges/rotation, one literal color frame, all ten-row complete relations, empty/nonempty fibres and every full lift.
D5/S4/root swap act simultaneously on the entire graph and all data; canonical933 q2 is retained; beta is not assumed to be a U-shield middle row.
